About this item

  • ERGONOMIC WORK CHAIR: The reliable office chair is purpose-built to encourage good posture. The backrest fits the shape of the human spine. In addition, it provides head/shoulder/back/ hips/ hands supporting points and proper lumbar support, thus reducing strain on your back, promoting proper posture, relieving the pressure on the buttocks. Ideal for home office, student study, executive work, reading and gaming scenarios.
  • SPACE-SAVING DESIGN WITH FLIP-UP ARMS: Easily tuck the chair under your desk with 90° flip-up armrests—ideal for small spaces. The padded arms are made of high-density foam wrapped in breathable mesh, offering a soft, supportive feel for all-day use.
  • ADJUSTABLE HEIGHT & TILTING FUNCTION: Find your perfect sitting position with 4" of seat height adjustment and a backrest that tilts up to 135° for a relaxing angle. Please note: the chair rocks back but does not lock in a reclined position—it returns upright automatically.
  • BREATHABLE MESH & CUSTOM LUMBAR SUPPORT: Stay cool and supported during long hours with a ventilated mesh back and a 3-inch thick high-density foam seat cushion. The lumbar support adjusts to three height levels to fit your spine and reduce back strain from extended sitting.
  • EASE OF ASSEMBLY: The home and office chair comes with installation tools and detailed instructions, even one person can assemble the perfect chair in just 15 minutes. We also provide 24-hour after-sales service, please feel free to contact us in case of missing parts, damaged products or any problems related to the chair
  • FABRIC CUSHION: The thick, fabric-padded seat of the budget office chair is well cushioned, anyone with back problems will appreciate the soft and comfortable seat experience. The fabric cushion and mesh back work in harmony to support your back without smothering your body
  • 360 DEGREE MOVEMENT AND STABILITY: The task chair uses smooth casters that can swivel horizontally 360° without resistance，low noise, so it won't hurt the floor while moving. It also moves smoothly on tile, wood, carpet and other floors
  • Dimensions: Suitable for people of about 5'5" to 6'2". Overall dimensions (including arms):25.5" W x 20" D x 43.3"-47.3",Height adjustable up to 4 inches. Seat dimensions: 19.5"L x 20.5"W x 3.1"D

  • What height range is this office chair suitable for?

    The chair's height is adjustable, making it suitable for users ranging from 5.3 to 6.4 feet tall.

  • Can the armrests be adjusted? Can they be flipped up?

    Yes, the armrests can be flipped up, allowing the chair to be pushed under the desk when not in use, saving space.

  • Can the chair tilt back? What is the maximum tilt angle?

    The chair supports tilting adjustment with a maximum tilt angle of 135 degrees. However, it does not support locking or reclining.

  • What should I pay attention to during installation?

    Please refer to the manual and select the correct screws for each part. Follow the recommended installation sequence. Loosely install all screws first, align all parts, then fully tighten all screws to ensure a secure and stable assembly.

  • Why does the chair lean forward?

    If the gas lift or base is not properly installed or securely fixed during assembly, it may cause the chair to lean forward.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Product Description

The desk chair features an ergonomic curved backrest that snugly conforms to the curve of your back. Its adjustable lumbar support safeguards your spine, alleviating back and spinal pain during extended work hours. The innovative Y-shaped bracket enhances the backrest's stability. The armrest can be rotated and easily placed under the table when lifted, saving space and facilitating storage. You can rest by rocking back and forth with the knob adjustment below the seat or lock it in place. It has a swinging angle for added comfort and a casual feel. Additionally, it offers a 360° swivel function. The streamlined cushion, filled with high-density sponge, is soft and elastic, reducing the discomfort of prolonged sitting. The adjustable padded armrests provide extra comfort and support for your arms
